defs: a company or a person that shows products at an exhibition
a paper or an e-mail that lets you enter an event
a small book with pictures and information about products
a big event where companies show their products
to write your name on a list to go to an event
an event where planes fly and people watch them
a very big room or building for an event

paras: Next week, Karina's company is attending SkyExpo, a big aviation exhibition in Orlando, in the United States. More than two hundred exhibitors are coming from many countries, and there is an airshow every afternoon.
On Monday, Karina is flying to Orlando with two people from her team. They are preparing the booth in Hall B, and they are bringing new brochures in English and Portuguese.

On Tuesday, the exhibition opens at nine a.m. Karina is meeting three clients at her booth: Mike from Miami, Kenji from Tokyo and a new client from Chile. Visitors need a ticket, but clients can register online for free.
On Wednesday afternoon, Karina is not working at the booth. She is watching the airshow with Mike and his partners. On Thursday night, she is flying back to Sao Paulo.

listenings.text: Hello, Ms. Macedo. This is Tom Hayes from the SkyExpo office in Orlando. Thank you for registering. Your booth is in Hall B, number forty-two. The exhibition is opening on Tuesday at nine a.m., but you can prepare your booth on Monday afternoon. We are sending you five free tickets for your clients. And the airshow is starting at three p.m. every day. See you next week!

Hi, Karina, it's Anna Brooks, from Brooks Flight School in Texas. I saw your name on the SkyExpo list. I'm attending, too! My team is bringing two training planes to the exhibition. I'm arriving in Orlando on Monday night. On Tuesday morning, I'm giving a short talk in Hall A about flight schools. Are you free on Wednesday? I'm having lunch with two exhibitors from Brazil, and I'd like you to meet them. Call me back!

extra_audio.text: First, Karina registers her company for SkyExpo. Then, her team prepares new brochures in English. Next, she flies to Orlando on Monday. After that, she meets three clients at her booth on Tuesday. Finally, she watches the airshow with Mike on Wednesday.
